results.name: Desktop initial render
results.details: Actual 1200×900 DPR1 WebGL meadow; 18 clumps, 108 flowers, local fonts, English UI, final public subpath.

results.name: Four botanical choices and six-flower raycast planting
results.details: Actual clicks planted exactly six of the chosen type each; existing types preserved; occupied patch rejected; two-phase GPU growth attributes populated.

results.name: Keyboard and wind
results.details: Canvas 1–4 selection, arrow ring movement, Enter/Space planting; focused slider retains arrow/number behavior; Still/Light/Gusty states and GPU shared wind updated.

results.name: Help/reset accessible dialogs
results.details: Native modal focus trap and Escape/return focus tested; help scrim dismisses; reset scrim does not; cancel preserves plants.

results.name: Orbit and wheel
results.details: Actual mouse drag and wheel changed camera without planting.

results.name: Deterministic reset
results.details: All seeded positions/heights/rotations exactly equal original state; camera, first flower and wind restored.

results.name: Actual PNG download and failure handling

details.toast: Your meadow is full. Reset to begin again.
details.method: Actual plant validation/state/pools, batched into one render to avoid software-GPU command backlog; not a hardware performance benchmark.

results.name: Reduced-motion live preference
results.details: Preference change freezes shader field, disables camera damping, plants immediately without growth stagger.

results.name: Desktop after-interaction layout
results.details: No horizontal overflow after all interactions.

results.name: Mobile actual touch controls
results.details: 390×844: selected bluebell and tapped six blooms; one-finger orbit and two-finger pinch change camera with no accidental planting; wind, help, reset, 44px targets, no overflow.

results.name: Resources and errors
results.details: All homepage/resource requests successful; zero request, HTTP, console or page errors in all viewports.

previewReview.assessment: 已通过 view 打开 ensurePreview 新生成的真实首屏；花园、文字、控件与最终桌面实现一致，非设计稿或占位图。
